title: midasu's backrooms
description: this project will add blocks from the backrooms.
body:
this mod adds the wallpaper, floors, lights, and ceilings from lvl0(more soon) of the backrooms and some of it sub levels, it also has a boime for if you want the vibe of the lvl you wanna build. we are aiming to recreate every level of the backrooms in this mod along with the youtube animations and blocks and decor from the movie later down the line.
this mod is great for recreating senses from the cain pixels series or making your own maps to use with friends or for rolplay purposes
